title: MuZero: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
description: AlphaZero required knowledge of the game rules to plan with MCTS. MuZero learns a model of the environment purely from experience — without any simulator — and uses that learned model for planning. Achieves superhuman performance in Atari, Go, Chess, and Shogi without being given the rules.
authors: Schrittwieser, Antonoglou, Hubert, Simonyan, Sifre, Schmitt, Guez, Lockhart, Hassabis, Graepel, Lillicrap, Silver (DeepMind)
